paragraphs: The name of a thief and armed bandit in the time of Rav Nachman; Bava Metzia 93b.

notes.text: Bava Metzia93b names Shabbu in a case brought before Rav Nachman. The frozen Hyman abbreviation is ר״ג; its discrepancy remains unresolved rather than being silently changed.

Hyman’s printed notice (vol. III, p. 1108) reads ר״נ where the supplied Hebrew reads ר״ג. Bava Metzia 93b places the case before Rav Nachman, and Rashi identifies Shabbu as the armed bandit. The translation reflects the print and the passage while the supplied Hebrew is preserved.
